about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey in the fantastical realm of Fantasy Shootoff, a free PvPvE fantasy game where you fight against enemy creatures and bosses, use crazy weapons, experience a thrilling story, and hang out with your friends on one big map. Play Single player and quest through the secrets of the island and level up your character or jump into Multiplayer and kill enemies with your friends. Fantasy Shootoff is constantly being updated so be ready.

Fantasy Shootoff takes place on a visually appealing map that is constantly changing with every new chapter and season.

Fantasy Shootoff has a large variety of different weapons, consumables, and Armor to pick from. Every item has its own special stats to fit that item.

Fantasy Shootoff's storyline always includes fighting enemy threats to protect a very special artifact known as the "Gem Of Life". Some enemy's are weak and some are very strong. 

Fantasy Shootoff has a complex and thrilling storyline that drives the center of the game. The Gem Of Life, the island, the Assault Team, and the I.C.E are key factors of the game's storyline.
detailed_description:
About Fantasy Shootoff

What Is Fantasy Shootoff?

Fantasy Shootoff is a free PvPvE fantasy game where you fight against enemy npcs or have a duel with your friends on one big map filled with crazy weapons, story and much more. Play Single player and level up your character or jump into Multiplayer and kill enemies or just hang out. Fantasy Shootoff is constantly being updated so be ready. In Fantasy Shootoff there are seasons and chapters. Unlike most games, Fantasy Shootoff's seasons last for one whole year and in each season there is 7-8 chapters. Chapters are about 2-3 months long. Chapters usually bring small map changes like adding new POI's, they also add new items and weapons to match the different themes for each chapter and they bring new story elements.

History of Operation Games

Operation Games was started by Steven Benoit Jr in 2020, at the time he was 12 years old. Steven loved to play video games and he always used to wonder how they where made. When he got his first PC he started looking up how to program. He started learning Unity, but he didn't like that way of programing, he wanted something easy for beginner's. After a while Steven started using Unreal Engine 4. He liked the easy viewport and blueprint programing. Steven then thought about putting together a small team to help him make video games. So at school he asked his friends and they all wanted to help. So they called the team "Epic Crazy Games". But that was to familiar with "Epic Games". So Steven renamed the team to "Operation Games".


Fantasy Shootoff Lore

By Operation Games

Note: This section is updated frequently.

Origin Of The Gem

Long ago-before the milky way, before our world, a red glowing neutron star was born. The star had such a strong gravitational pull that the remaining gases around the star formed a ring around it and beams of radiation and gas from its magnetic poles. But this strong gravitational pull was also its flaw. The star couldn’t stand it and it imploded, sending massive amounts of elements, gases and radiation into space. Then gravity grabbed a hold of the elements, gases and radiation, and contracted it to a very small point-forming a Gem shaped object. The Gem still had a gravitational pull and after years of silence a planet formed around the Gem. And the Gem sat in silence for thousands of years. In the year 2023, the radiation finally crashed into Earth-creating beautiful auroras in the sky. Also catching the attention of different space stations and experts.      

SEASON 1

In the year 2025, Earth began to die and decay, so a young woman decided to start a mission to help the planet survive. She formed a small organization to research a power source capable of keeping Earth alive.

After a few months of research, they detected a power source so strong it could sustain the planet. When they unearthed it, they discovered it was a gem. Further testing revealed that the gem could not be placed too close to the ground, or it would destabilize Earth’s core, and it could not be placed too high, or it would lose its effect. To solve this problem, she created a tower that extended deep toward Earth’s core. At the top of the tower sat the Gem of Life. She named the organization the Assault Team (A.T.).Knowing others would try to control the Gem of Life, she constructed an artificial mountain to protect and hide it.

After a year, another organization known as L.A.V. discovered the Gem of Life and pinged its location. When the Assault Team found out, they created a small elite force called I.C.E. (Island Combat Enforcers) The purpose of I.C.E. was to defend the Tower/Gem of Life from any threat.

After three years of fighting between L.A.V. and I.C.E., a truce was formed when a new and far greater threat revealed itself. This threat came from outer space. They were not human.

They were known as the Invaders.

SEASON 2

When the Invaders arrived at the location of the Gem of Life, they began their invasion. They caused massive damage to the Assault Team’s operations, even destroying the Tower of Life and damaging reality itself. This forced the leader of the Assault Team to relocate both the tower and the gem.

During the war between the Assault Team and the Invaders, the Invaders’ mothership fired upon the Tower of Life. The tower was destroyed, and the gem struck the ground, cracking and creating a massive tear in the sky. The tear began pulling in anything nearby. The Invaders’ mothership was the closest object and was sucked into the tear. It was later expelled—corrupted and transformed.

The Invaders became a new alien species known as the Grims.

SEASON 3

The Grims learned how to operate without being detected, creating a massive problem for the Assault Team. They constructed towers designed to teleport their world into Earth’s reality.

The plan failed, but the consequences were severe. Instead of merging worlds, the towers pulled landmarks from different realities into Earth’s world. This was the moment the Assault Team realized that reality itself was fractured—and that Earth was connected to far more than just its own galaxy.

The Assault Team began researching this discovery and created a plan to relocate the Gem of Life far from Earth. They identified a distant, unstable galaxy capable of containing the gem’s energy without immediately destroying Earth.

The Assault Team linked the Gem of Life directly to Earth and relocated both the Tower of Life and the Gem of Life into this newly designated galaxy.

Their goal was to create a controlled, isolated environment where the gem could operate safely—and eventually prepare the galaxy to support life. This plan was called Operation Reset.

All members of I.C.E. were teleported to the new galaxy, known as Galaxy GOL659.

SEASON 4

After the Gem of Life was transported to Galaxy GOL659, the Grims followed and continued the fight. Soon, the space and land surrounding the tower began to corrupt. Over time, the Gem of Life could no longer withstand the immense energy the Assault Team was using to support Earth from such a distance.

The gem exploded, sending chunks of fractured land and matter outward across the galaxy. Using its remaining energy, the gem pulled these fragments together, forming a massive island to protect itself. It then sealed itself away in stone.

The enormous energy release echoed across Galaxy GOL659, attracting attention from many different beings. Eventually, a research team arrived and began building laboratories and mining operations on the island.

The Assault Team and I.C.E. demanded they leave, but the group refused. War began.

After Project G7 was defeated, the island returned to peace. To celebrate, the island’s residents held a massive party. During the celebration, a meteor crashed into the island.

Most residents ignored it—but the Assault Team did not.

Later, an I.C.E. guard intercepted a strange audio signal over their radio. The Assault Team traced the signal and discovered it was coming from the meteor. They panicked, but it was already too late. The meteor opened, revealing an alien queen named Void. She came to the island to summon her army, kill the island’s residents, steal the Gem of Life, and use its power to destroy the entire galaxy. Void began constructing pyramids across the island to open portals for her army. Once the Crosspoint was completed, she initiated her invasion. The I.C.E. and the island’s residents evacuated using a time machine created by the Assault Team. With no other option left, the Assault Team overloaded the Gem of Life, destroying Void. The time machine sent I.C.E. back to a snapshot of 2026 (Season 1, Chapter 3), when the original I.C.E. and L.A.V. were still fighting. The new I.C.E. replaced their past counterparts and continued the battle.

A few months later, the Assault Team reactivated the time machine. They explained that sending everyone back in time gave the Gem of Life time to heal after Void’s attack.

The Assault Team then led everyone outside—revealing a new island.


FAQ

Fantasy Shootoff's Frequently Asked Questions

What rating is Fantasy Shootoff?

Fantasy Shootoff is rated Teen 14+ for Fantasy Violence and Users Interact.

How often will the game update?

Fantasy Shootoff will receive regular updates that include improvements, balancing and fixes. We’ll keep you updated as to what that content looks like as we move through the new seasons and chapters.

How long do seasons and chapters last?

Most chapters last about 2-3 months, seasons will last about a year depending on how many chapters there are.

How do I download Fantasy Shootoff?

To download Fantasy Shootoff go to the Steam store page and add it to your library and press the download button and wait for it to finish and start playing.

How do I find my IP Address for multiplayer?

Open the command prompt and type "ipconfig" and press enter then your IP address will appear.
